```csharp
public enum PoseBakeRejection
```

The reason baked samples were judged unusable. Returned by `PoseBake.TryValidate`, [PoseBakeSampler](../pose-bake-sampler/) and the bake tracks, and collected in [BakePlaybackController](../bake-playback-controller/). Not being able to use a bake is part of normal operation (without baked data, the picture can still come from your own fallback computation), so instead of a single `bool`, the value tells which assumption failed.

`TargetMoved`, `ObserverEyeRequired` and `UserCameraOverride` are never returned by Omni's tracks themselves. You set them on `BakePlaybackController.ExternalOverride` to stop applying baked poses. See [Sequencer and Pose Bake](../../../docs/guides/sequencer/) for details.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | Usable; nothing was rejected. |
| `MissingAsset` | `1` | No `PoseBake` is set on the clip. Also returned when `null` is passed to the sampler. |
| `FormatVersionMismatch` | `2` | The data format version differs from the current implementation (`PoseBake.CurrentFormatVersion`). |
| `PrecisionMismatch` | `3` | The fixed-point layout (total bits, fractional bits, rotation fractional bits) differs between bake time and now. The meaning of the values has changed, so the bake is rejected rather than repacked. |
| `SceneMismatch` | `4` | The baked Scene differs from the Scene being checked against. |
| `SourceMismatch` | `5` | The baked sequence (Timeline) differs from the sequence being checked against. |
| `ContentHashMismatch` | `6` | The content hash differs: the sequence or the layout changed after baking. |
| `EmptySamples` | `7` | There are no samples, the interval is 0 or less, or a channel's array lengths do not match the declaration. |
| `TimeOutOfRange` | `8` | The track has no clip with weight at the current time. Times outside the baked range do not cause this reason; they hold at the edge sample. |
| `ChannelUnavailable` | `9` | The `PoseBake` has no channel with the specified identifier. |
| `TargetUnresolved` | `10` | No write target (`Omni.Logical.Transform` or `Light`) is bound to the track. |
| `TargetMoved` | `11` | The target's position differs between bake time and now. Used by setting it on `ExternalOverride`. |
| `ObserverEyeRequired` | `12` | An observer eye offset is required. Baked data is in absolute Logical coordinates, so it cannot be used. Used by setting it on `ExternalOverride`. |
| `UserCameraOverride` | `13` | The user has taken control of the camera, so the sequence pose must not overwrite it. Used by setting it on `ExternalOverride`. |
| `InterpolationFailed` | `14` | Restoring or interpolating a Logical value, or converting it to a Unity rotation, failed. |
